data.claim: Pre-file triage is not yet a shipped default rule: the AGENTS.md block (ddflow/services/adopt/_rules.py _SECTION) and the shipped help pages carry no pre-file triage checklist.
data.falsifier: At least one shipped surface already contains the full pre-file triage checklist.
data.mechanism: The AGENTS.md block text is generated solely from _SECTION in ddflow/services/adopt/_rules.py, and the shipped help pages live under ddflow/templates/prompts/help/; neither surface contains the six triage items (or 'triage' at all except review_triage).
data.probe_output: no matches (manual.md 'triage' hits are review_triage, not pre-file triage). _SECTION=394 words currently.
data.question: Does ddflow ship a pre-file triage checklist to every managed project?

evidence.note: R25ac39888e CONFIRMED: neither _SECTION in ddflow/services/adopt/_rules.py nor ddflow/templates/prompts/help/ ships a pre-file triage checklist (grep found no 'pre-file triage'/'closable overlap'/'person-decisions'; manual.md 'triage' hits are review_triage). Test-first parity test will fail until the text ships.

ddflow brief --item RL-file-pretriage: loaded r-task-phase-needs-wave (phase+needs+wave tag), r-gemini-key-load (export GEMINI_API_KEY before gemini review), r-reuse-core, r-ddflow-self-assessment + ranked lessons digest.

Commit 95987fbd0 in the worktree branch ddflow/RL-file-pretriage: added Pre-file triage to _SECTION (ddflow/services/adopt/_rules.py, block stays 399 words < 400) and the full 6-item checklist to ddflow/templates/prompts/help/workflow.md; new parity test tests/test_pre_file_triage.py pins both surfaces. Globs widened via --add-globs to the real default-rule files.

chunk_findings.detail: The new pre-file triage rule tells agents to file every new task or bug “with `--needs` and a wave tag”, but it never encodes the required no-prerequisite case. Given a task with no dependencies, an agent following this text may omit the required `no-deps` tag (or attempt to supply an empty/invalid `--needs`), which violates [r-task-phase-needs-wave]: “A task with no prerequisite carries the tag `no-deps`, so that none is a decision and not an omission.” The full checklist in `ddflow/templates/prompts/help/workflow.md` has the same omission, so the standard rule surface fails to tell agents how to handle no-dep work.
chunk_findings.title: ddflow/services/adopt/_rules.py:_SECTION

chunk_findings.detail: The managed-block test only greps for a few phrases and never asserts that the triage rule applies to bugs or includes the required phase, so a regression that narrows the shipped rule to tasks and drops phase can still pass. For example, if `project_body()` returns a rule containing “Pre-file triage before filing a task: duplicate or closable, check what is planned, reuse core modules, prior research, person-decisions, wave tag --needs”, every asserted phrase is present, but the rule no longer covers bug filing and omits the phase requirement mandated by [r-task-phase-needs-wave].
chunk_findings.title: tests/test_pre_file_triage.py:test_the_managed_block_ships_the_triage_checklist

chunk_findings.detail: The workflow-help test is vacuous as a “full checklist” guard because it only checks that isolated phrases occur somewhere in the rendered topic and does not require them to appear under a Pre-file triage section or in an affirmative rule. A workflow.md containing an unrelated warning or anti-pattern such as “duplicate or a closable overlap; what is already planned; reusable, extensible core modules; never re-derive; person-decisions; wave; --needs; right phase; create one” satisfies every assertion even though it does not ship the intended triage checklist.
chunk_findings.title: tests/test_pre_file_triage.py:test_the_workflow_help_ships_the_full_triage_checklist

chunk_findings.detail: The added pre-file triage sentence still mis-encodes the required no-prerequisite case. For a new task or bug with no dependencies, the managed AGENTS.md rule says to file it “with `--needs` (or `no-deps`) and a wave tag”, which reads as passing `no-deps` as a needs value while still adding a wave tag; the workflow surface instead says the `wave` tag is `no-deps`. [r-task-phase-needs-wave] requires the no-prerequisite case to be represented by the `no-deps` tag, not by a dependency entry. An agent following the shipped managed block can therefore create a bogus dependency on `no-deps` or file the wrong wave/no-deps tag. The earlier “fix” does not answer this because it only inserted a parenthetical without placing `no-deps` in the wave/tag slot or saying to omit `--needs` when there is no prerequisite.
chunk_findings.title: ddflow/services/adopt/_rules.py:_SECTION

chunk_findings.detail: The workflow-help test does not actually pin the dependency/phase part of the pre-file triage rule. It only asserts the prefix `6. File it with a `wave` tag` and that `no-deps` appears somewhere, so a regression that narrows the shipped workflow checklist to `6. File it with a `wave` tag (`no-deps` when it has no prerequisite)` would pass while omitting `--needs`, the required phase, and “create one if none fits.” That would let the shipped help drift away from [r-task-phase-needs-wave] even though the test still calls itself a full checklist guard.
